## Interfaces

Affidavit at 95816892 (`phase/standalone-aff`) strips store verbs: deleted check/close_batch/aa/aa_resolve/policy and affidavit.tmux; `affidavit/cli.py` and `bin/aff` expose only `verdict`; `tests/test_standalone_cli.py` covers verdict without runtime on PATH, non-zero exit for `check`/`close-batch --help`, and `verdict --help` exit 0; `tests/test_evidence_layout.py` scans `affidavit/**/*.py` for forbidden store tokens and asserts store modules absent plus protocol docs. Orchestra at 2f2054ae hosts copied store client (`orchestra/check.py`, `close_batch.py`, `aa.py`, `aa_resolve.py`, `policy.py`), `orchestra/cli.py`, `bin/orchestra` (check/close-batch, same launcher pattern as `bin/aff`), root `affidavit.tmux`, and retargeted tests; `orchestra/suite.py` and `dashboard/artifact_store.py` import orchestra modules; `orchestra/close_batch.py` imports `affidavit.oracle_red.is_assertion_level_red`; skills use `orchestra check` / `orchestra close-batch` and retain `aff verdict`; `tests/test_orchestra_commands.py`, `tests/test_affidavit_import_boundary.py`, and help/readme tests in `tests/test_affidavit_check.py` lock those boundaries.

## Assumptions

Review used `/tmp/standalone-aff-reviewer-brief.md` (work-item Approach, standalone-aff requirements/acceptances/invariants, phase diffs); ignored execution/check-run/assessment text; read-only inspection of the two phase-head trees plus selective pytest (standalone CLI/layout, orchestra import boundary, skill commands, help/readme); did not run full moved test suites from verify-standalone-aff step 4.

## Invariants

R1/R2 — affidavit Python has no forbidden store tokens; `bin/aff` verdict-only behavior matches acceptance (help exits verified). R3/R4 — store modules and `bin/orchestra` live in orchestra; close path uses `affidavit.oracle_red`; AST boundary test reports no forbidden `affidavit.{aa,aa_resolve,check,policy,verdict}` under `orchestra/` or `dashboard/`; affidavit package does not import orchestra. R5 — skill scan finds no `aff check`/`aff close-batch` invocations; execute-phase and verify-work retain manifest `aff verdict` wording. Design — single `oracle_red` implementation shared by verdict and close; verdict docstring states no record store; `ensure_affidavit_importable` bare `import affidavit` remains for path setup (allowed by boundary test, documented in orchestra `__init__.py`).
